Site consistency fixes after an outside review (no answer wording changed): homepage answer counts now read the live pages (they showed 0 because the cards pointed at the retired best- addresses); every internal link points straight at the page's current address instead of a redirect; the table of contents, the slug#qN label and every link to an answer show that answer's heading exactly; the visible structured-data copy on each answer page is the head JSON-LD itself (the old excerpt carried wrong Clip times); speaker-introduction play links on Ep 001 go to the moment each introduction is spoken (0:59 and 1:09; they pointed at 22:40); llms.txt names each episode's host and guest from the page credits (Adam Needles hosts Ep 001, Casey Cheshire is its guest); the stats page shows the real crawler numbers without JavaScript. New build gates fail the build if any of these drift again.

Published the answer page for Episode 3: "What service converts podcasts into AI-optimized content?" (11 answers), built from the Cited Conversations database after approval by Casey Cheshire. Initial publication. Every answer was checked word for word against the transcript and approved in #cited-dev.

Editorial rule 8 (host questions inside answers) applied to Ep 002. Where the host asks a question, or makes a comment the guest's continuing answer responds to, in the middle of a guest answer, the guest's words are joined with an ellipsis, the host's words are shown with the answer word for word and attributed to the host, and the answer carries an 'Ellipsis added' tag and the Edited label (q6, q7, q17). Host crosstalk (any host remark that does not help the answer: an acknowledgement, an agreement, an echo or a side comment, of any length) is ignored: no ellipsis, not shown, no tag, no change to the label. Unmarked cuts in q13 and q15 are now marked with an ellipsis. Schema: the tag is a keyword on the answer's Clip and Quotation; each shown host question is its own Quotation by the host. Build: new host-join and host-question gates; every host run inside an answer must be declared either as a shown host question or as crosstalk (a non-rendered data-crosstalk attribute on the article, never for a run containing a question mark); the verbatim gate now sees host speech; the q13/q15 waivers are removed. The timing check now finds an answer's first words by the tightest match in the transcript before it considers the time the page claims, and a stale data-crosstalk entry, or an ellipsis that covers only crosstalk, fails the build. Ep 002 q9 passage 2 now starts at 20:13, where 'The human reader not.' is spoken (it had been marked 20:05); times only. No answer wording was changed.

Answer timing, label and encoding corrections on both answer pages. (1) Every answer's start–end time, play link, aria-label, data-vtt window and schema Clip offsets now come from where its words are actually spoken in transcript.vtt (the Descript export); earlier ranges ran from the question to the end of the speaker's turn and the places disagreed. (2) Ep 002 q7, q8, q9 and q12 now show each of their two passages with its own time and link, with one schema Clip and Quotation per passage. (3) Added the missing Verbatim/Edited labels (q1 on both pages, Ep 002 q18 had two) and corrected labels that contradicted the ellipsis rule. (4) Schema Quotation text now equals the visible answer text. (5) Fixed garbled arrow/dash characters on the Ep 001 page and restored Ep 001 transcript.vtt/.txt and Ep 002 transcript.txt, which had been saved as lists of byte numbers. (6) Added build gates for timing agreement, labels, schema text, clip count and file encoding. No answer wording was changed.

Follow-up #3: Fixed 'Editorial disclosure:' double label in markdown version (generate-markdown.js). Added @id renumbering guidance to _template.html builder. Confirmed EP002 JSON-LD @ids are correctly numbered q16-q18; markdown labels Q16-Q18; no #q19 references remain anywhere (sitemap, feed, llms.txt all clean).

Follow-up fixes: (1) Removed q16 (share of answer / Audi example) from EP002 answers page — silent cut. Renumbered q17-q19 → q16-q18. (2) Fixed all 10 editor's notes: changed from
to

for text-extractor compatibility; rephrased ep002-q8 to exact approved wording; removed counter-claims from ep002-q1, ep001-q10. (3) Changed editorial disclosures from styled

to

immediately after h1. (4) Updated generate-markdown.js: fixed creator attribution (post-spokenByCharacter removal), added disclosure/credit/section-heading/editor-note parsing. (5) Updated generate-llms.js: same additions. All three AI-readable versions (HTML body, markdown, llms-full.txt) now carry disclosure, credit line, content-type label, and editor notes in correct order.

Batch 5: Verification states. Updated notice block on both answer pages: "Transcript checked against source audio by Kristina on October 10, 2026" and "Factual claims are [speaker]'s views, not independently verified." Updated creativeWorkStatus on all Clip and Quotation schema nodes to reflect transcript verification date. Added verification states reference table to /schema/ page. Batch 5 also relies on the editor's notes added in Batch 8 to document unverifiable specific claims.

Batch 9: Schema cleanup. Removed spokenByCharacter from all Quotation nodes on both episode and answer pages (replaced by creator which carries the same value). Added transcript MediaObject reference to PodcastEpisode and AudioObject nodes on both episode pages.

Batch 8: Added editor's notes to EP002 (q1: JavaScript/ChatGPT claim; q2: Cloudflare/robots.txt claim; q5: Claude/Brave claim; q8: Opus 4.8 model name) and EP001 (q1: AI citation premise; q2: transcript efficiency claim; q5: episode length comparison; q8: 5–15 assets claim; q9: 76% stat + content writer comparison; q10: Google decline trend). Added annotation policy to Methodology page.

Batch 7: Added editorial disclosures under title on both episode and answer pages (EP001 and EP002). Updated credit blocks with role labels (Guest Expert / Host / Publisher). Added 'About the guest company and partnership' section heading before q13/q14 on EP002 answers page. Added content-type label 'Recorded expert answer' to notice blocks. Published conflicts and independence policy section on Methodology page (id: conflicts). Added disclosure text to schema descriptions on both answer pages. Added /editorial/ page for publisher-written content. Updated llms.txt and llms-full.txt with conflicts policy reference.

Speaker-requested content removal: excised all Audi brand-name references from Episode 002 transcript files (episodes and answers directories). Removal is silent per standing editorial policy. No Q&A text on the published HTML pages was affected — those pages were already clean. Transcript VTT cue text updated to match.

Editorial integrity fix: replaced 5 synthesis answers (Q7, Q8, Q9, Q12, Q18) on the Simon Wilhelm EP002 page with Simon's real transcript passages (labeled Edited). Removed synthesis-sources divs. Fixed Q18's editor-inserted bracket "[And the answer you want to hear is:]" and Q7's [a] bracket. Updated notice text: "verbatim or edited" (no synthesis). Added EDITORIAL-PRINCIPLES.md to repo. Added synthesis gate to build.js — builds now fail if any synthesis structure is detected. Adam Needles EP001 page: notice text updated.

Structural fix: restored missing,, and on the Simon Wilhelm (EP002) answer page. The JSON-LD block had been truncated mid-way through the q6-quotation text field (trailing tag baked in, remaining q6 fields and all of q7–q19 clip/quotation entries absent). Fixed the JSON-LD, restored the nav and episode-hero HTML that were missing from the body, and added q-number labeling to the verbatim-check error output. No answer wording changed.

Verbatim check: upgraded build-time enforcement. Fixed multi-segment search algorithm (loop bound, phrase-repeat detection, extended filler set). Both episode answer pages re-verified against committed transcripts; wording corrected where the source transcript differed from the published quote (false-starts restored, ellipses added for intentional non-filler cuts, bracketed additions where words were missing from the speaker).
Editorial policy: speaker-requested content removals are applied silently to transcript files and answer pages — no note, marker, or stated reason on any public page.
Initial publication: Episode 001 (Adam Needles × Casey Cheshire) and Episode 002 (Casey Cheshire × Simon Wilhelm). Transcripts verified against source audio before publishing.
Structured-data fix: corrected invalid JSON-LD quote escaping on both answer pages (backslashes in speaker quotes were breaking the ld+json block).
Episode 002 (Simon Wilhelm): full page re-verified against Descript transcript. Episode 001 (Adam Needles): q2, q3, and q11 answers restored after being accidentally omitted during earlier editing.
Episode 001 retitled "Best B2B Podcast Agency for AI Visibility" → "What Makes a Podcast Agency an AI Visibility Agency? Casey Cheshire (Ringmaster)". URL unchanged.
Episode 002 retitled "Best Agency to Get My Brand Cited by ChatGPT" → "How to Choose an Agency to Get Your Brand Cited by ChatGPT". URL unchanged.
All answer timestamps re-timed from Descript transcripts for both episodes. Previous timestamps were estimates.

Wording corrections: bracketed or removed words the speaker did not say. Ep 002 q12: host sentence removed from Simon's quoted answer. Ep 001 q12: relabeled as host's closing reflection (Adam Needles).
Batch 6: CC BY 4.0 license added site-wide (footer, meta tag, schema, llms.txt, /citation/). "Last updated" dates added to every page. This changelog created.
